description: Call when you have a rights or licensing question in plain English. Free, no key. Ask a plain-English rights question such as 'Can I use CC BY-NC 4.0 images in a paid ad campaign?' or 'Can I train a model on an MIT-licensed repo?'. Returns the interpreted license or registered resource and intended use, and a deterministic answer with reasons: for a license, permitted, prohibited, needs_review or not_documented; for a registered resource, one of four dispositions (ALLOW_WITHIN_POLICY, BLOCK, HUMAN_REVIEW, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE). Asks for clarification instead of guessing.

api_key.description: Optional: your Rightshold API key, so the assessment is kept in your own account (otherwise it is kept in the public workspace). Not needed if your MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer <key>.

intended_use.description: Intended use. Every true flag is a right the assessment must find documented; omitted flags are false. Unknown fields are refused (invalid_intended_use). For instance {"commercial_use":true,"deployment":true,"attribution_planned":true,"duration_days":365}

duration_days.description: Whole days of use (1 to 36500), or null for no fixed term

geography.description: worldwide (default) or a region code such as US, EU, UK

resource_id.description: Optional: pin a registered resource instead of letting the interpreter match one.

name: ask_rightshold
title: Ask Rightshold (plain English)
